mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE selected_regions AS ( SELECT region_id FROM regions WHERE region_name = #{region} AND parent_region_id IS NULL
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT child.region_id FROM regions AS child JOIN selected_regions AS parent ON child.parent_region_id = parent.region_id )
SELECT r.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, r.restaurant_name AS restaurantName, r.description, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT_WS(' · ', parent.region_name, rg.region_name) ORDER BY rg.sort_order, rg.region_id SEPARATOR '、' ) FROM restaurant_regions AS rr JOIN regions AS rg ON rg.region_id = rr.region_id LEFT JOIN regions AS parent ON parent.region_id = rg.parent_region_id WHERE rr.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ) AS regionNames, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( c.category_name ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.category_id SEPARATOR '、' ) FROM restaurant_categories AS rc JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = rc.category_id WHERE rc.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ) AS categoryNames, ( SELECT ri.image_path FROM restaurant_images AS ri WHERE ri.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ORDER BY ri.sort_order ASC, ri.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imagePath FROM restaurants AS r WHERE r.status = 'PUBLIC'
AND LOCATE(TRIM(#{keyword}), r.restaurant_name) > 0
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM restaurant_regions AS rr JOIN selected_regions AS sr ON sr.region_id = rr.region_id WHERE rr.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM restaurant_categories AS rc JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = rc.category_id WHERE rc.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id AND ( c.category_name = #{category} OR (#{category} = '和食' AND c.category_code = 'JAPANESE') ) )
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.restaurant_id DESC

SELECT r.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, r.restaurant_name AS restaurantName, r.address, r.business_hours AS businessHours, r.closed_days AS closedDays, r.budget_min AS budgetMin, r.budget_max AS budgetMax, r.description, ( SELECT AVG(rv.rating) FROM reviews AS rv WHERE rv.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ) AS averageRating, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews AS rv WHERE rv.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ) AS reviewCount, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT_WS(' · ', parent.region_name, rg.region_name) ORDER BY rg.sort_order, rg.region_id SEPARATOR '、' ) FROM restaurant_regions AS rr JOIN regions AS rg ON rg.region_id = rr.region_id LEFT JOIN regions AS parent ON parent.region_id = rg.parent_region_id WHERE rr.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ) AS regionNames, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( c.category_name ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.category_id SEPARATOR '、' ) FROM restaurant_categories AS rc JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = rc.category_id WHERE rc.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ) AS categoryNames, ( SELECT ri.image_path FROM restaurant_images AS ri WHERE ri.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id ORDER BY ri.sort_order, ri.image_id LIMIT 1 ) AS imagePath FROM restaurants AS r WHERE r.restaurant_id = #{restaurantId} AND r.status = 'PUBLIC'
SELECT m.menu_name AS menuName, m.price FROM restaurant_menus AS m WHERE m.restaurant_id = #{restaurantId} ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, m.menu_id ASC
